title: TSM Industrial Capital Project Recovery: Governed Project Intelligence
_note: Scripted scenario: engine outputs are canned via tests/e2e/helpers/stub-war-room.js, not live model output. Captions are DRAFTS. Narration lines are DRAFTS too: spoken text for --narrate, numbers written as words.

states.caption: Industrial Capital Project Recovery war room
states.narration: This is the Industrial Capital Project Recovery war room. It is where a slipping project gets a plan. What follows is a simulated incident.

states.caption: Schedule-slip report loaded
states.narration: Late switchgear has pushed the critical path of a plant expansion back by six weeks. The operator loads the schedule-slip report.

states.caption: Six engines complete: risk scored 68/100
states.narration: Six engines work the report. Phase Two completion moves from March to May, and two commissioning milestones are at risk. Exposure runs from nine hundred thousand to one point seven million dollars. The risk score is sixty-eight out of one hundred.

states.caption: Operations Strategist receives the capital-project relay
states.narration: One click sends the case to the Operations Strategist, which shows what the exposure becomes with action, and without it.

states.caption: Executive Portal with the capital-project relay
states.narration: The Executive Portal presents the decision: approve the resequencing of the civil and electrical packages within two days, for sixty thousand dollars. The system recommends. The project director decides.
